video_title: Postgame Media Availability with Bennett Stirtz | OKC Thunder | November 4, 2026

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on OKC's internal focus during back-to-back games
quotes.excerpt: more of the focus at shootaround today and during the game was what can we do better
quotes.quote: They switched a little bit of the things up that they were doing the last game, so I think more of the focus at shootaround today and during the game was what can we do better. We weren't focused about them as much as what can we do better in different coverages and defense and offense.
quotes.social_post: Bennett Stirtz says the Thunder focused on internal improvements rather than the opponent during their recent back to back games. He noted the team prioritized what can we do better in different coverages on both ends of the floor.

structured.context: Bennett Stirtz discusses the team's internal focus on improving their own execution rather than focusing on the opponent during a back-to-back set.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz credits veteran leadership for young players' rapid development
quotes.excerpt: it's credit to all the players who have been here, all the vets, and they're just telling us
quotes.quote: It's just taking a lot of reps and that's credit to all the players who have been here, all the vets, and they're just telling us what to do. I think we're getting better each game, but it's credit to all the other guys on the team and the coaching.
quotes.social_post: Bennett Stirtz credits the veteran leadership on the Thunder roster for the rapid development of the team young players. He says the vets are constantly telling us what to do to help the group get better each game.

structured.context: Bennett Stirtz credits the veteran players and coaching staff for helping the younger players develop through consistent repetition.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on the team's progress early in the season
quotes.excerpt: all the young guys are getting more and more comfortable, so we're still trying to get there
quotes.quote: I think all the young guys are getting more and more comfortable, so we're still trying to get there. It's early on in the season, we got a long way to go, but it's a step in the right direction.
quotes.social_post: Bennett Stirtz believes the Thunder young core is getting more comfortable as the season progresses. He says while they have a long way to go it is a step in the right direction.

structured.context: Bennett Stirtz reflects on the early season progress and the increasing comfort level of the younger players on the roster.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on maintaining a next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: just next man up mentality, had no idea this was going to happen to start the season
quotes.quote: Just next man up mentality, had no idea this was going to happen to start the season, so just ready when my name's called. It's pretty much it.
quotes.social_post: Bennett Stirtz on his mindset as a young player in the rotation. He says he had no idea this was going to happen to start the season but he is maintaining a next man up mentality and staying ready when my name is called.

structured.context: Bennett Stirtz explains his mindset regarding being prepared to play whenever his number is called by the coaching staff.
